name: The Satchel of Helpful Goods from the Dungeon Finder holds gear for Conquest of Azeroth classes
contract: The 56-60 Classic Random completion satchel (52002) opens with its four reward slots for a stock class and for a Conquest of Azeroth class alike. Its class conditions list only the stock class masks, so a Conquest of Azeroth class opens it empty.

steps.label: The stock class satchel offers its four slots
The Conquest of Azeroth class satchel is not empty
